subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list timestamp and last-message preview land independently, or be folded into the broader sessions overview and title/sorting direction?
rationale: Backend preview support already exists, but multiple narrow implementation attempts closed unmerged and the issue overlaps #80901, #81781, and #51028.

options.title: Land narrow preview
options.body: Render a bounded last-message preview in the existing Control UI Sessions table using the current includeLastMessage backend support.

options.title: Fold into broader overview
options.body: Keep this issue open as input to the larger sessions overview, derived title, and meaningful-activity sorting design instead of landing table-only UI now.

options.title: Defer previews
options.body: Leave the Sessions table as metadata-only until maintainers are ready to redesign session discovery more broadly.

recommendation.title: Land narrow preview
recommendation.body: Render a bounded last-message preview in the existing Control UI Sessions table using the current includeLastMessage backend support.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI Sessions work makes this the closest owner for choosing the table-level UX direction.
